programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Hide The Lightning
programme.desc: Po and team go to the city of Tikal to get more information on the Protector, but it's easier said than done, since nobody in the town actually knows the identity of the Protector. Blade becomes increasingly frustrated and Po attempts to help her.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Beast
programme.desc: Po and team play a game of Pok-ta-pok against a family of armadillos for the opportunity to talk one on one with Zuma, the leader. The game brings out a highly competitive and aggressive side to Blade, known as "The Beast." Back in China, Colin and Weimin find the Pirate Queen and become part of her pirate crew.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Dogfight Days of Summer
programme.desc: With Morando and his Armada heading for Earth, Aja and Krel clash with Vex and Zadra over how to handle the situation. Vex and Zadra want to alert human authorities, while the Royal teens seek out a more creative solution -- video games.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Mother's Day
programme.desc: The arrival of Tronos - a bounty hunter with the power to control electricity - sparks an investigation by Area 49-B that threatens to expose the Royals’ alien identities. Meanwhile, Mother watches as the Royals struggle to work together to deal with this new threat.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Ill Gotten Gains
programme.desc: When Colonel Kubritz issues a medical quarantine that locks down the high school, Aja and Krel must avoid capture with help from their friends. Meanwhile Vex, Zadra, and Stuart have a run-in with a familiar face.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when there's no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the "Whoopsies!" Song.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Easter Kitty Bunny
programme.desc: It’s Easter-time in the dollhouse! When Gabby unboxes an Easter basket with an orange egg inside, all the Gabby Cats want to know what’s inside, but when CatRat accidentally sends it rolling out of Kitty Fairy’s garden, Gabby and Pandy go on a springtime search through the Dollhouse to find it. Then, when the egg hatches, they meet Eggy, the Easter Kitty Bunny! For our Cat of the Day segment, Baby Box gets crafty.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Detectives
programme.desc: There's a mystery in the dollhouse! When things start to mysteriously disappear around the dollhouse, Gabby and Pandy play detectives, using all their senses to find clues, follow them, and solve the mystery. For our COTD segment, CatRat and Baby Me-Owls show us how to make ice cube paints!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: When CatRat gets stuck on planet Caturn, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go save him. DJ Catnip teaches them a song to remember how to get there and Baby Box helps them make jetpacks so they can zip around. In the Cat-osphere, they take a twirl through Space Swirls and zip through the Supergallactic Doughnut Hole and even meet DJ Catnip's cousin, DJ Comet! For the Cat of the Day Segment, Baby Box and DJ Comet show us how to craft a papier-mâché Caturn.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Ants Work Together
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Ants didn't work together. The Ants desperately wanted to build themselves a home, but all the animals kept sitting on them, or sneezing them far away or swooping them up into tall trees! On the point of giving up, one brave, young soldier ant rallies the troops… "Pamoja! Together! Together they can do anything!!!"… and he was right. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Flea Jumps
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Flea didn't jump. Flea didn't really move at all. She was very big and very round. All Flea wanted to do was to see the world. The Tinga Tinga animals try to help lift Flea high up, but she is too heavy. Then Tortoise comes up with an idea ‘Movement and activity!' and after many attempts Flea discovers that she can jump. She can jump really high! Then Flea can jump everywhere and see everything.! Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Bouncing Bulb
programme.desc: Pat's Special Delivery is a very large, very fragile lighthouse bulb, and everything seems to be conspiring to make him break it! Falling timber, an out of control sofa, Bonnie the dog, high winds...! Pat's journey from the sorting office to Pencaster Bay is a minefield of hazards. Waiting for the bulb is lighthouse keeper Chris Beacon and his pet parrot Micawber, both anxious to get the lighthouse working before sundown, and tracking a storm blowing in.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Lost Pigeon
programme.desc: The Thompson's family pigeon, Cedric, has been reported found in Northern Ireland. Pat must take Dorothy and Bill to help bring him back in the SDS Plane. Meanwhile Alf camps out at the sorting office, pining for his beloved Cedric's return. Once in Ireland, Pat meets the man who found Cedric and Dorothy manages to charm him down from his roof. Unfortunately an inopportune phone call from Alf startles cedric and causes him to take up a roost on a cliff face with a friendly puffin.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Marsha Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Marsha overhears the others saying she is too bossy. She decides that Silver hatch would be a better place without her. Chaos swiftly ensues, can Marsha be persuaded to stay, they can't cope without her!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Let's Hear It For Big Chris
programme.desc: Big Chris is working on Loada while the others plan a surprise evening for him for being the longest serving member of Silver hatch

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Funny Business
programme.desc: Big Chris receives a mysterious parcel… the cars are intrigued to find out what is in it. Strange and silly things start happening at the workshop, could it have anything to do with Big Chris' package?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Nick Solves The Case
programme.desc: PC Pete has been summonsed to get to the bottom of some missing fuel. But where's Nick? And who can solve the case?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Disappearing Rainbow
programme.desc: It's Fable Forest Rainbow Day when the big rainbow in Fable Forest sparkles and pops like a giant firework. Everyone is looking forward to it until the colours start fading from the rainbow! Noddy needs to investigate before the rainbow disappears for good! Revs converts into a helicopter so that Noddy and Bumpy can fly over the rainbow to find the pot of rainbow gold. They discover that Cloppycorn has been taking the gold from the pot to give his unicorn horn a special golden glow.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Flying Toy
programme.desc: When Noddy sees Deltoid flying in the air he decides to investigate: how can they get Deltoid down? Realising that magic is involved, Noddy goes to see Queen Sparklewings to see if she can help but she tells him her wand has gone missing. Someone must be trying to do magic with her wand! Meanwhile more flying toys appear, first Fuse and then Smartysaurus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Spooky Noise
programme.desc: The Naughticorns have borrowed Noddy's music player to practise a special dance for Pat-Pat's Pumpkin Party. But when Noddy arrives at the party, the other toys are all scared by a strange noise. Noddy decides to investigate: what's making the scary noise? Using his investigating skills and following all the clues, Noddy arrives at the Naughticorn Stables where he realises that the scary noise is actually a slowed down tune on the music player.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Upset Animals
programme.desc: Something upsets all the animals at the farm at night and no one can get to sleep . Farmer Tom asks Noddy to investigate before night falls so that everyone can go to sleep properly. Using his wwwbook to gather clues and using all his investigation skills Noddy travels all over Toyland to find out what has been disturbing the animals. He works out that the new stickers that PatPat gave to the the animals are made out of glow in the dark paper.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cakey’s Cupcake Cousins
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a tin full of Cakey-like cupcake kitties, she realizes... Cakey's Cousins are coming to visit! Cakey welcomes his Cousins to the dollhouse and leads them through a fun-filled itinerary of activities, but quickly realizes his cousins have an agenda of their own. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Pillow Cat sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
programme.desc: Gabby and Pandy accidentally get turned teeny-tiny when one of Mercat's potions spills. To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Mecha-Menace
programme.desc: Magnus and Axel unveil their new "mechano-dragon." It's impressive at first, but the Riders set out to prove it's no better than a bucket of bolts.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Summer Holiday
programme.desc: In need of some rest and relaxation, the Riders head out on vacation. But their supposedly perfect island getaway isn't quite what they hoped for.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Yarn Fairy Bake It ‘Til You Make It
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think they're a mysterious "Yarn Fairy," and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Disappearing Rainbow

He works out that the new stickers that PatPat gave to the the animals are made out of glow in the dark paper.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Fairy Tales
programme.desc: The Gabby Cats put their own spin on the classic fairytales "Rapunzel," "The Princess and the Pea," and "Little Red Riding Hood." For the Cat of the Day Segment, CatRat sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Happy CAT-O-Ween
programme.desc: It’s Cat-O-Ween in the dollhouse, and all the Gabby Cats are in the holiday spirit. Gabby and Pandy dress up and go trick-or-treating around the dollhouse, where they make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for hidden treats with MerCat, and make Banana ghosts with Cakey. Along the way, CatRat plays silly tricks on them, but in the end Floyd manages to trick them all! For the Cat of the Day segment, all the Gabby Cats sing a special Cat-O-Ween song.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Sea Monsters Puff Fruit
programme.desc: Rumors of scary sea monsters in the East End take the kids on a journey of discovering you shouldn’t believe everything you hear. Mysterious globs disturbing the ocean turn out to be the byproduct of food from Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Chef J's Tale
programme.desc: Chef J tells a tale about unicorns sailing in ships on clouds in search of Unicorn Land.

programme.title: Go Dog Go! S2 - Chaser and Chewer: Part Flea Sing For Your Pupper
programme.desc: It’s another adventure with Tag and Scooch dressed up as their favorite comic book characters: Chaser and Chewer! But this time, bad guy Thunder (Frank) is asking for their help, because Flea (Beans) is trying to take over the town on his own. When Tag and Scooch find out Wagnes has always dreamt of becoming a famous country music singer, they decide to make her dream come true.

programme.title: Go Dog Go! S2 - Dogcathalon
programme.desc: Mayor Sniffington mixed up the dates for the Dogcathalon and it turns out it’s being held today! Panicked, Tag and Scooch rush off to make sure the three race spots are race ready so they can be approved by the Top Dog. The Dogcathalon Race has officially started! Tag goes into Crew Chief mode, running around to ensure Team Pawston is ready for each part of the race. But with Sam unable to race, he encourages Tag to take his place and win it all for Pawston.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Wind
programme.desc: A fierce windstorm traps the gang inside the garage and they have fun together all night, but once the food runs out they team up to find a way out.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Arabian Nightmares
programme.desc: When Al goes out of town, he puts the PALs in charge of the ramada, but they get more than they bargained for when three trouble-making horses escape

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Thunk O'clock High The Croo-Gitive
programme.desc: Thunk must face a bully that's notorious for being an animalThe Croods flee after Grug is accused of robbing caves and stealing food for the Broods

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - A Few Good Grugs Valley Shine Day
programme.desc: The Valley has the first "try-all" against the Croods to see if Grug stole food for the Broods; Thunk asks Kevin to teach him to be more irresistible

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Total Nightmare
programme.desc: When Hookfang is drawn to a female Monstrous Nightmare, Snotlout tries to break them up before he loses his friend forever.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Team Astrid
programme.desc: After Dagur attacks Berk, Astrid trauns a crew of back-up Dragon riders to battle back, although no one anticipates how soon the strike will come.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - One Last Job
programme.desc: The team plans a heist in order to obtain the enchanted pendant that can lead them to the storm wheels. Elsewhere, Klaus and Veruca shipwreck on a mysterious island that is actually home to the mages, and also the Tianshang weapon helmet.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Doom and Groom
programme.desc: Po and the team have one last attempt to get the pendant, but they will have to disrupt Jayesh's wedding, and contend with his guards, to do so. At the mage island, Klaus and Veruca get hold of the Tianshang helmet.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Mission to CATurn
programme.desc: When CatRat gets stuck on planet Caturn, it's up to Gabby and Pandy to go save him. DJ Catnip teaches them a song to remember how to get there and Baby Box helps them make jetpacks so they can zip around. programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Cupcake Tree
programme.desc: When the Gabby Cats get stuck in the leaves of an overgrown cupcake tree, it's up to Gabby, Pandy and cupcake-expert Cakey to work together to shrink the overgrown cupcake tree branch by branch--and to save CatRat from where he's stuck at the top! For our COTD segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S1 - Wrinkles & Stickles
programme.desc: After Turtleneck is captured by Frederic Estes, Boss Baby and Tim attempt to rescue her, leading them to the terrifying "fun house" at the town fair

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Bossa Nova
programme.desc: After Boss Baby is fired from Baby Corp;he attempts to navigate regular baby life in a MommyDaddyBaby playgroup. Even worse;the playgroup’s other new member is Mega Fat;whose animatronic stuffie Wagby malfunctions and threatens the safety of the whole group. Meanwhile;Tim does everything he can to avoid doing his homework.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - The Museum Job
programme.desc: When the crowded bathroom situation at the local museum threatens baby love;Boss Baby leads his new team of playgroup babies on their first mission…and then their SECOND mission after a klepto baby in their group swipes a priceless artifact. In a continued attempt to avoid homework;Tim joins Boss Baby on his mission.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Taxing Trauma of the Treacherous Tattle Trials Part I
programme.desc: In part one of a two-part season finale, the Melvins create a final exam that George and Harold will be sure to fail: the Doom Dome. To ensure success, Melvinborg injects Melvin's cells with nanobots, giving him heightened powers. programme.desc: Aja and Krel travel into their parents’ memories in pursuit of Morando - and the truth about Gaylen’s Core. But when the King and Queen’s lives are jeopardized, a trusted ally makes a sacrifice that will change the team forever.

programme.desc: With their parents nearly regenerated and Morando in pursuit of Gaylen’s Core, Aja, Krel, and Vex unite with Toby and Arrgh on a quest into the depths of Trollmarket to unearth the relic before it ends up in the wrong hands.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - No Can Do Adopt-A-Toad
programme.desc: Chet is determined to open a giant can of tomato juice lands in town and Turbo worries that Chet is becoming obsessed with the can. Turbo donates his race winnings an animal charity, but accidentally adopts a toad who moves into the clubhouse and becomes an obnoxious house guest.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Buster Move Gills!
programme.desc: Smoove Move is embarrassed when his nerdy brother comes to visit. Skidmark causes a panic when he hunts a snail-eating goldfish at a fancy party.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Stuck in Skates Lawn Circles
programme.desc: After ice skating with his pen pal, Archibald can't remove his too-tight skates. Crackridge has crop circles. Could aliens really be responsible?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Toyland Mischief Maker
programme.desc: When Big Ears' teapot goes missing, Noddy is surprised to find it hanging from a lamp post. And when Bumpy's kennel goes missing too, it's clear there's a mischief maker in Toyland. Noddy needs to investigate before Toyland descends into chaos. Using his investigating kit and with Revs and Bumpy to help, Noddy discovers that it was the Naughticorns playing a game of Dare and daring each other to do silly things.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Popping Balloons
programme.desc: Noddy and his friends are each given a balloon at the end of Smartysaurus's Science Party. But when lots of the balloons start going pop, Noddy decides to investigate why. Realising that someone must be hiding and popping them, he follows the clues to PatPat and then to the Naughticorns before eventually working out that the balloon poppers are the Ninjas.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Pink Lettuces
programme.desc: Something very strange is happening at the farm - all Farmer Tom's lettuces have been painted pink! Farmer Tom is really upset so Noddy offers to investigate. After talking to PatPat and Smartysaurus he realises that the Ninjas had asked Smartysaurus to make them pink paint so that they could paint the lettuces. They were using them as pom-poms to cheerlead Pink Ninja as she ran the Toyland Marathon Race! The Ninjas are very sorry that they upset Farmer Tom but he tells them that it's alright.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Jigsaw Puzzle Pieces
programme.desc: When some pieces from Big Ears' jigsaw puzzle go missing, Noddy investigates: where are the missing pieces? He soon realises someone must have taken them and draws up a list of suspects. Having discounted the Pirates and then the Naughticorns, Noddy is baffled. But when Pat-Pat and the Pockets invite him to share a piece of toy cake, Noddy suddenly has a breakthrough: maybe it wasn't one toy who took lots of pieces but lots of toys who each took one piece.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Bees Sting
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Bees didn't sting. All the animals loved the Bees and they especially loved their sweet and yummy honey. The trouble was all the precious honey was disappearing and there was a honey crisis in Tinga Tinga. Something had to be done. Luckily clever old Tortoise has a cunning plan. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Peacock Struts
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Peacock didn't strut. He was a very proud bird and he wanted to be the best at everything. He wanted to be the best bird-brain in Tinga Tinga. He wanted to be the best flyer in Tinga Tinga and he wanted to have the biggest and the best tail in Tinga Tinga…. But as Lion so wisely points out ‘Sometimes it's not good to get everything you want!' Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Clippy Claws
programme.desc: Pat has a very special delivery today! Micawber's claws need clipping and Pat needs to deliver not only the claw clippers but Amy the vet too! On the way to the lighthouse though they encounter all sorts of animals needing help today - from a poorly Bonnie with a cold to a fretful Pumpkin who doesn't want to take his horse pills!

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Sorting Machine
programme.desc: Pat and Jess are called to Cardiff to collect a new sorting machine when the Pencaster machine breaks down.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Mum's The Word
programme.desc: Christine (Big Chris' mum) is visiting Silver hatch. As is Mamma Mia… serious competition ensues!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - How The Hatch Was Won
programme.desc: Tin Top is feeling homesick so Big Chris tries to cheer him up. But who could that pesky varmint causing trouble on the track be?!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Go Gadget James And Maxi
programme.desc: Maxi is jealous of all of James' gadgets, or more precisely, the attention the other cars give him. He persuades Molecom to devise some gadgets for him… with hilarious results

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Mr Carburettor Or Bust
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor has commissioned a bust of himself for Silver Hatch. Disaster strikes when it is dropped, Big Chris tries to make amends, while Marsha distracts Mr Carburettor and the reporter

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Moving Train Tracks
programme.desc: Queen Sparklewings is having a fairy picnic in Fable Forest that evening. Everyone offers to help set up for the picnic but Queen Sparklewings tells them not to worry - the fairies can do it all. Later, when Noddy and all his friends are approaching Fable Forest Station on the train they discover someone has redirected the train tracks. They can't get to Fable Forest. How will they have the picnic in time? Noddy needs to investigate why the train tracks have been moved.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The King Of Toyland
programme.desc: Noddy returns from a Make and Take party at Pat-Pat's and finds the Builders are constructing a big orange palace in Toy Green. by order of the King of Toyland! Noddy decides to investigate: who is the mysterious King of Toyland? He spots the Knights carrying a royal litter, but all he can see inside is the top of an orange crown. Realising the King's favourite colour must be orange, Noddy remembers seeing Pat-Pat painting a bowl of oranges and wonders if she knows who the King is.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Flyaway Balloons
programme.desc: Everyone is decorating special balloons in Toyland. They're going to have a big Balloon Release at the end of the day and see how far they can fly. But when Noddy returns in the afternoon with Big Ears, the balloons have already flown away! Noddy decides to investigate. Following all the clues, he arrives at Deltoid's house. The action hero toy tells him that he only took back his specially decorated balloon. The others were still there earlier.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S1 - The Case Of The Missing Brick
programme.desc: Noddy and his friends are building a toy tower. Carlton is joining in and having a great time. They've almost finished when one of the brick pieces goes missing! Oh no. How can they finish the tower without the last brick? Noddy needs to investigate. Using his detecting skills Noddy soon finds the missing brick.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when there's no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the "Whoopsies!" Song.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Hot, Hot, Hot
programme.desc: Aggro is embarrassed about big changes she's going through. And when she gets stuck in a volcano, the Rescue Riders seek help from ... Magnus?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Hot, Hot, Hot
programme.desc: When a mama Ironclaw dragon gets caught high on a mountain with a broken wing, Hannahr the blacksmith has to confront her fear of heights to help out.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Tanaka's Moving Castle Zenko Don't Go
programme.desc: Mr. Tanaka is moving places all by himself, so Team Zenko step in to assist, and learn the importance of asking people for help. When Sam's skateboard competition falls on the same day as her favourite creator Ken KaBlam's comic book signing, TZG secretly prevents him leaving town before she gets the chance to meet him.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Berry Race The Artist
programme.desc: The kids have a race to decide who gets to try some extremely rare berries. When Scallop finds a beautiful and mysterious sea sculpture, she enlists the help of her friends to search the sea for the artist behind the masterpiece.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Winkly Fest Snow
programme.desc: When Pixie struggles to recreate an old tradition perfectly, the kids realize they can make their own traditions. A story told by Chef J inspires Juniper to go in search of snow.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Old Dog, New Tricks \ Snoozie-Hullabaloozie
programme.desc: Tag chooses to pair up with her Grandpaw for the Barker Family Talent Show, and together, they search for their winning talent. \ Tag is surprised to learn that today is the Pawston Snoozie-a-Hullabaloozie. With everything shut down for the day, Tag and Scooch take the opportunity to play all over town, while trying not to wake up other dogs.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Show Dog, Show \ Keys to Victory
programme.desc: Tag can't wait to show off her car at the car show. But when Cheddar Biscuit wants to come along and pick up her clown friends along the way, Tag is wary that Cheddar Biscuit will steal her thunder. \ The Not Yet Cadets can't wait to watch Sam’s big race. But when Sam loses his car key, he challenges the Not Yet Cadets to race around town to find it.

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Slide
programme.desc: Half dinosaur! Half construction truck! Full-on fun! Watch giant Ty Rux, his little buddy Revvit and the crew come face-to-face with evil D-Structs.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Resolutionary Fever
programme.desc: Lucky rushes to complete all of last year’s resolutions before the clock strikes midnight on New Year’s Eve

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - They Might Be Sky Giants The Grugest Story Ever Told
programme.desc: After getting hit on the head, Eep has a vision and sets out to get the Valley to show how thankful they are; Grug feels like he's the biggest joke in Ahhh Valley, so he asks Thunk to make a "buy-o-pic" of him to show people just how truly great he is

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Worms Of Endearment Dr Strangegrug Or How I Learned To Stop Worrying And Love The Spear
programme.desc: Lerk and Thunk hide all the valley's worms in a cave to protect them from the hunters who want to use them as bait; Grug invents the spear and pitches it to the Valley as a tool that will change cavemanity forever!

programme.desc: After a strange creature bites Tuffnut, he believes he'll turn into a legendary Lycanwing dragon when the moon is full unless his friends can save him

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S1 - Snoutlout Gets The Axe
programme.desc: When Snotlout and Astrid must fly a ceremonial battle axe to a family wedding, they must work together when an Armorwing dragon derails their plan

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Hide The Lightning
programme.desc: Po and team go to the city of Tikal to get more information on the Protector, but it's easier said than done, since nobody in the town actually knows the identity of the Protector. Blade becomes increasingly frustrated and Po attempts to help her.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - The Beast
programme.desc: Po and team play a game of Pok-ta-pok against a family of armadillos for the opportunity to talk one on one with Zuma, the leader. The game brings out a highly competitive and aggressive side to Blade, known as "The Beast." Back in China, Colin and Weimin find the Pirate Queen and become part of her pirate crew.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Fluffy Flufferton
programme.desc: Feline popstar sensation Fluffy Flufferton is performing a concert at the Dollhouse Hotel, and Gabby unboxes tickets to see her! Gabby meets Fluffy and discovers that she’s afraid to try new things because she doesn’t want to make mistakes-why mess with perfection? But with the help of the Gabby Cats, Fluffy learns how to fail fantastically and be the most fluff-tastic version of herself. For our Cat of the Day segment, DJ Catnip sings a song about the Dollhouse Hotel.

programme.desc: Boss thought that breaking his arm was painful;but the true pain starts at pediatrician Dr. Kevin’s "jokes." Boss enlists the playgroup babies to defang the doctor of his "comedian’s disease." Tim obsesses about keeping his little brother safe.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Escape From Krinkle's
programme.desc: Boss has an opportunity to get his old job back at Baby Corp;but to get the interview;he’ll need the playgroup babies to help him escape Marsha Krinkle’s super-safe Bubbeezee playroom. Tim nearly misses Kabob Day at school.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Puppy Party!
programme.desc: Boss comes face to face with his old nemesis;Bug The Pug;after the playgroup parents decide to throw a Puppy Party. Staci creates a "No-Paperworkist" movement to avoid Buddy From HR’s constant paperwork.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Celestial Vault
programme.desc: Shashi stages a race up the privately-owned Mount Zebulon, and he invites Tony, Cisco, and Margaret "Echo" Pearl to participate. The crew soon discovers that Shashi is using the race to steal another super-car (this time from space!) - and he knows that Tony is working with the feds.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Final Key
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere tells the kids that the failed mission is over, but Tony isn’t ready to give up, and he’s determined to rescue Frostee. The crew goes rogue by deciding to steal the final key from Shashi and trade it for their friend.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ignition
programme.desc: Shashi finally reveals his master plan.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Shell Shocked Part 1

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Shell Shocked Part 2
programme.desc: An extremely powerful new dragon attacks Dragon's Edge, and Hiccup makes a dangerous alliance while the fate of the Dragon Eye hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Enemy Of My Enemy
programme.desc: After Hiccup is shot down on a remote island while searching for Viggo and the Dragon Hunters, he questions Dagur's intentions to rescue him.

programme.desc: Toby, Claire, and Blinky work to keep the human world unaware of Jim’s absence as they look for ways to rescue him from the Darklands

programme.title: PL MOMENTS - EP8
programme.desc: Join Togo and African football icon Emmanuel Adebayor as he relives his top 10 Premier League moments. From iconic goals to unforgettable rivalries, this inspiring and entertaining show is packed with candid insights, untold stories, and the passion that defined his career.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP51
programme.desc: As the curtain comes down on Everton's time at Goodison Park, PL Stories takes a poignant look back at one of English football's most iconic grounds. For over 130 years, Goodison has been more than just a stadium; it's been a home, a fortress, and the stage for countless moments of triumph, heartbreak, and unforgettable drama.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP39
programme.desc: Fresh from lifting the Africa Cup of Nations trophy with Senegal, Iliman Ndiaye reflects on a journey defined by resilience, imagination and quiet determination. From the academy pitches of France to the unforgiving grounds of non-league Boreham Wood, and on to the bright lights of the Premier League with Everton, we trace a rise that defied convention and expectation at every turn.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP46
programme.desc: We step inside the world of Tijjani Reijnders, joining him at home with his family in Manchester as he reflects on his remarkable rise to the top of the game. From his early beginnings to the bright lights of Manchester City, Reijnders opens up about the pivotal moments that shaped his career, the challenges he's overcome, and the ambitions that continue to drive him.

programme.title: NETBUSTERS - ERLING HAALAND'S 100
programme.desc: We celebrate Erling Haaland's record-breaking haul in true Netbusters' style, showcasing every one of his 100 Premier League goals, squeezed into a special 26-minute show.

programme.title: PL STORIES - EP40
programme.desc: We mark International Women's Day by celebrating the women shaping refereeing across the professional game. programme.title: MATCH OFFICIALS MIC'D UP - TUES 14 APR
programme.desc: Join PGMOL Chief Refereeing Officer Howard Webb and former Premier League star Michael Owen, as they use previously un-released audio from the on-field officials and VAR teams to explain refereeing decisions. programme.title: When a Man Loves a Woman - EP6
programme.desc: Man (Kwok Tsun On), Fai (Ng Chun Yu), Wah (Esther Kwan) and Shan (Fennie Yuen) grew up together and were very good friends. Man, Fai and Shan even shared an apartment. Fai was a playboy. He liked fooling around without any commitment. Man, on the other hand, was very loyal to his girlfriend - Wah._x000D__x000D_Man and Fai treated Shan as their brothers since she acted like a tom-boy. However, Shan was in love with Fai.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP16
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Speakers Of Law - EP1
programme.desc: Kam Bing-shun (Kenneth Ma) is a top law student. However, due to a miscarriage of justice, he decides to follow the path to becoming a Legal Executive. By means of his diplomatic and tactful approach, Bing-shun gradually builds his own brand, Adviser Kam. The law firm where Adviser Kam works abruptly faces the prospect of closing down. He uses networking to defuse the situation. He is also invited by lawyers Tin Yau-ka (Lam Ha Mei) and Yu Kwok-tung (Stephen Wong) to join their team.

programme.title: Succession War - EP7
programme.desc: HESHEN (Ruco Chan) supports PRINCE YONGYAN (Shaun Tam) to accede to the throne. Following QIANLONG’s death, EMPEROR JIAQING manages to convince HESHEN’s son FENGSHEN-YINDE (Matthew Ho) and confidant FUCHANG’AN (Joel Chan) to turn their coat, seeking to sweepingly eliminate HESHEN and his cronies. But, HESHEN comes prepared.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP22
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第457集
programme.desc: 台视60周年台庆大戏《美丽人生》第五单元《壮志高飞》，以1960年代高雄市旗津岛为故事起点，三位最美丽的台湾女人，在台湾最美丽的年代，在最美丽的旗津，悲欢交织而成的美丽人生。数百年前，旗津还没有一个统一的名称，岛的南端依旧与高雄相连。 而后，为了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名唤『崩隙』的这片沙土挖空了，居民被迫迁移，旗津也因而断开 了与台湾的连系，犹如游子，离开了母亲的怀抱。土地会消失，历史也许会被淡忘，但曾经走过那段艰辛岁月的人们，他们的悲欢离合、笑容与泪水，仍将会转化为孕育后代子孙的养分，开出灿烂的花朵。这是属于我们上一代人的故事，也是我们这一代人的故事，是所有在这座岛屿上奋斗的人们的—《

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第458集

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第11集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志为人医守护爱2.0第35集
programme.desc:
什么是有温度的医疗？什么是医疗之魂？医疗团队除了在诊间、在手术室、在病房抢救生命之外，还能做些什么？
『志为人医守护爱』带您目击动人的温馨医病情现场，透过医疗团队的视病如亲、 以病为师的坚持、病患与医疗团队的互相感恩，体会与感受现代人医如何帮助病患重拾信心，在他们人生低潮时重新出发，进而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第73集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 行动现场第474集
programme.desc:
爱，不漏接，做，就对了！
台湾社会贫富悬殊、强弱失衡，现有政策与资源难以弭平，在国家发展到了一定程度后，最终希望世界大同、人人平等，迈向福利理想国，但社福法规、人力、经费及各方资源都不足分配，无法周全，得靠民间力量自我体现，多少填补缺口。慈济志工为数甚众，是台湾最有组织与规模的NGO，借由众多的人间菩萨散布各乡镇村里，或许能照顾到乏人闻问的黯淡角落。
我们希望提供一个行动平台，让各方NGO团体无论大小，以及无分年纪与工作的爱心公民，参与分工这张绵密的爱心网，网住所有被制度漏接、需要帮助的人。

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第73集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第48集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 仁心慧语第652集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧来自于内心，由内心启悟的智慧也最真实。证严 上人说：「做该做的事就是智慧，做不该做的事就是愚痴。」十个问题、十个解方，都是言者生命经验的体现，透过名人的智慧哲理，足以启迪人心，振聋发瞆，重新思考人生的价值。

programme.title: 叩叩叩到你家第6集
programme.desc: 生在台湾，长在台湾，你认识台湾吗？台湾说大不大，说小也不小，各个角落，你曾探索过吗？都市、乡下，山上、离岛，生活大不同，跟著小主播的脚步，上山下海拜访朋友，一起来认识台湾！

programme.title: 蔬果生活志第74集
programme.desc: 关于「吃」，该怎么吃得有智慧、吃出健康和营养呢？ 了解台湾不同时节、气候的丰富物产，透过农人的智慧和汗水，告诉您食材的生命故事，并且体验背后的价值与感动。

programme.title: 月娘第2集
programme.desc: 薛月，一个哈玛星鱼市场大盘商家的千金小姐，平日喜欢去看歌仔戏及追星的浪漫女孩。讲义气又爱布施，传承自种公益田做善事的父亲。 颇有佛缘的她，曾经梦见自己是观世音菩萨旁的侍女，因而想出家修行，令薛家父母忙著替她相亲找对象。然而阿月自有爱情的憧憬，不论出身好坏，只要彼此心灵契合，她相信就能厮守一生。 就这样，阿月遇见了在左营军乐队服役的郑添吉，两人因乐曲而相知相恋，阿月眼中，他就像是戏里贫穷却不失志的小生，阿月相信只要相爱，就能突破困顿，迎向幸福。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第648集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第81集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 倚天屠龙记第36集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龙宝刀再现江湖，武林各派你争我夺，激起一场腥风血雨！武当派张翠山与天鹰教殷素素因屠龙刀而相识、相恋，成亲生子，也因屠龙刀而丧命，留下孤儿张无忌。张无忌少年奇遇，修炼九阳神功有成！因祸得福，习乾坤大挪移脱险！拯救明教灭教之祸，被推举为教主！排解六大派纷争，誓死对抗蒙古人！。同时，蒙古郡主赵敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷离、波斯少女小昭对他的倾慕，让他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，爱中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演员lt;br/>曾舜晞 饰 张无忌lt;br/>陈钰琪 饰 赵 敏lt;br/>祝绪丹 饰 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 饰 灭绝师太lt;br/>黑 子 饰 金毛狮王 谢 逊lt;br/>许雅

programme.title: 倚天屠龙记第37集

programme.title: 包青天第90集

programme.desc: 十六岁的小风（麦子），拒绝上学、整天把自己关在房间，甚至不跟爸爸阿民（庄凯勋）讲话，这一天，她突然失踪了！与小风相依为命的阿民著急的到处找寻她，直至接到警察电话，才发现她竟然为了见网友，翘家到台北去了。阿民气急败坏连夜从台南杀到台北找到小风，没想到她竟又趁他睡著跑走…

programme.title: 如果大象不死第1集
programme.desc: 位于马来西亚柔佛州的大象村，有个美丽的传说：大象村的大象会保护著村民免受于马来虎的攻击，带给了村民安宁。直到1969年代某一天，村子里就再也没有任何大象的叫声，而人们也不愿再度提及这项事情，想说可能这件事情就过去了。可是，到了1999年，却因为村子出现了几位马来人，导致长辈们想起了当年大象消失的契机，而阿国与雅思敏这对小玩伴却也因此卷入了村子的新仇旧恨之中……

programme.desc: 健康是国家繁荣和个人生活的基石，而运动是保持健康的关键。因此，公共电视与教育部携手合作，策划了一个名为《就是爱运动》的节目。透过每一集的介绍，我们希望让观众更深入了解国内各项体育发展的情况，并培养对运动的热爱和支持。同时，我们也期望能够激发观众对运动的兴趣，并鼓励他们积极参与运动。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2809集
programme.desc: 单元多，可创造明快的节目节奏！不同的单元，犹如一个个不一样的抽屉，彼此的区隔明确清楚。 多样的单元，各有各的教育目标及观赏乐趣。不一样的孩子可以找到自己喜欢和认同的单元。幼儿的学习并非逻辑式的。单元式的学习方式，更能符合幼儿的学习与发展。综合杂志型态的节目类型，可以针对幼儿做全方位的生活学习。

programme.title: 艋舺的女人第16集
programme.desc: 一段发生在保守的时代，想爱却无法爱的故事。两个失去至爱，必须相濡以沫、共组家庭的女人。虽然她们没有丈夫，但却拥有彼此。

programme.title: 公视晚间新闻第105集

programme.title: 真情部落格第784集
programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: 福气人生第403集
programme.desc: 要拥有福气人生，可以透过聆听牧师们以台语分享圣经的真理，让你领受天国满满的福气与祝福。这些牧师们将以深入浅出的方式解释圣经，将其应用于当代生活，让你明白神的心意和计划。通过聆听台语讲道，你可以更深入地理解圣经的教导，并在日常生活中实践。这些讲道将提供实际的指引和智慧，帮助你在家庭、工作、人际关系等各个领域经历神的福气。聆听这样的讲道，你将能够领悟到属天的价值观和生活方式，学习依靠圣灵的带领，活出基督徒的身份和见证。这将使你能够更深入地体验神的爱和恩典，并将其传递给他人。

programme.title: 恩典365第1502集
programme.desc: 跟随寇绍恩牧师，每天五分钟，领受上帝的话语，并将其应用到实际生活中。这样我们可以每天都在上帝的爱和恩典中浸泡。

programme.desc: 「学学嘴学学鼻」与孩子们唱唱跳跳学客语，期望从学龄前幼儿到国高中生，皆能从中找到语言、文化的趣味，或学习从不同观点看世界。

programme.title: 奥林p客第1596集
programme.desc: 在新的对话中，主持人和机器人阿蓝妹将增加科技互动的元素。参赛孩子们将扮演小博士的角色，从各种主题和发明中学习现代科学和未来科技。每一集将以「一大六小」的竞赛形式进行，并引入四选一的卡牌抽选机制，让孩子们学习团队合作，并在面对不同意见时学会沟通和做出抉择。

programme.title: 客家戏曲第708集
programme.desc: 由多个著名客家剧团，分别演出相当脍炙人口的小说故事，希望能让大家再次回味童年看戏的滋味，也能让更多人欣赏到客家的传统大戏。

programme.title: 暗夜新闻第105集
programme.desc: 暗夜客话新闻是全国唯一主播、记者以全客语发音的新闻频道，并 详实显示字幕，除了著眼于「客家观点」的重要新闻议题、呈现客家生活 习俗与传统文化之外，更尽力发掘社会各阶层客家乡亲的故事。暗夜客话新闻针对四节新闻播出镜面，以桐花、蓝衫等各种不同主题的客家元素为基础，作全面的视觉设计，让收视大众们能够耳目一新、零时差的掌握，最具客家观点的新闻呈现。

programme.title: 飞越客庄第8集
programme.desc: 借助一套先进的高机动无人机装置，我们能够轻松模拟飞鸟俯瞰的视角，以优雅的姿态穿梭于繁华的街道和幽静的小巷，完整纪录下台湾客庄的人文风情和自然景观。这套设备拥有各种变幻莫测的摄影角度，能够生动地呈现客庄所发生的故事，并以独特的视角展现现代客家文化的发展脉络。

programme.title: 溜面线杂货店第7集
programme.desc: 节目场景复刻了早期客庄邻里间最热闹、也最能聊天的杂货店前空地。在这里，没有刻板的说教，只有银发长辈与主持人，像在大树下乘凉般，自在地聊生活、聊烦恼，也聊那些平常说不出口的心事。

programme.title: 谁来作客第88集
programme.desc: 一个以「客」为尊的节目，邀请嘉宾以轻松闲聊的方式闲话家常。

programme.title: 迈向未来的倒数10秒第1集
programme.desc: 讲述放弃拳击梦想、妻子早逝的桐泽祥吾，已经丧失活著的希望，在非本意地成为松叶台高校拳击部教练后找回热血并且重生，在与横冲直撞的高中生相处中诚实面对自己，进而迈向了新的未来。

programme.title: 国际新闻-客观世界第98集
programme.desc: 是一个专注于国际时事的新闻节目，以客观、中立的角度报导全球各地的重要新闻事件。节目内容涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的议题，旨在向观众传递真实可信的消息，让观众全面了解世界各地的动态，增进对国际事务的理解和视野。

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗第18季:第9集
programme.desc: 西北号船长席格在捕捉红眼雪蟹时，女儿曼蒂也即将临盆，而且疑似有前置血管的症状，这个消息让席格与他的女婿克拉克非常担心，于是他们转移阵地到靠近沿岸的渔场，准备随时返航。传说号的杰克船长遍寻不著裸盖鱼的踪迹，因此他求助派翠西亚李号的利普，却不慎让两艘船的鱼笼和蟹笼缠在一起，杰克感到非常自责，最后用金帝王蟹的情报挽回合作关系。

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗第18季:第10集

programme.title: 渔人的搏斗第18季:第11集

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第3季:第26集
programme.desc: 夏威夷开鲁亚的朋友裘尼尔通知艾伦当地有一场仓库拍卖会，艾伦和汤决定前往一试。但因为他们这次离家很远，所以决定带一位助理凯若琳，以协助两人在岛上卖掉全部物品。拍卖会上许多人看起来虎视眈眈，对这些外来人士更是不怀好意。原本艾伦等人打算保持低调，等到发现真正喜欢的仓库才出手，想不到第一间仓库就看到很有利润的水耕设备，只好直接竞标。虽然他们成功标下仓库，却也引起当地人的不悦，因此到了第二间仓库拍卖时，艾伦和汤决定让个子娇小的凯若琳出价，希望或许当地人会低估她。眼看著凯若琳即将得标，想不到现场有人直接加码，意图非常明显，就是要让艾伦等人知道外人不该到夏威夷撒野。接下来五间仓库陆续以高价卖出，艾伦等人只能

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 见证美洲极南端巴塔哥尼亚的荒野生机，包含美洲狮雪山狩猎、跳岩企鹅挑战巨浪、锹形虫攀树，以及虎鲸与象鼻海豹的生存竞争。

programme.title: 单挑荒野第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 艾德史塔佛独自留在非洲的干旱之国纳米比亚待上十天，他想挑战自我，看自己是否能在这种环境下生存，并且长期居住下去。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第13季:第2集
programme.desc: 德鲁决定将公司搬到康威，跟商店在同一个地方上班，为了扩张市场，他到诺福克古董市集买下眼镜行展示柜，跟鲁伯特希区考克买下毛边胡桃木桌及军用木箱。

programme.title: 麦克布鲁尔-天生车商第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 麦克和蜜雪儿决定要扩展生意规模后，麦克决定要举办第一汽车的首届车展，同时进行汽车拍卖。

programme.title: 翻新中古车第18季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集翻新中古车，麦克相中英国车史上最丑的车款之一，奥斯汀阿勒格罗。尽管阿勒格罗是出了名的烂车，麦克却认为凡登普拉的版本已有所强化，且卖家的车况保持良好，内装近似全新，于是坚持买下。之后由艾维斯处理悬吊系统和喷漆，麦克则把仪表板拿去重新印膜，总算让这辆车里外都焕然一新。最后前往水上伯顿参加车聚，见到许多外观奇特的怪车，也成功搭上真心喜爱凡登普拉的买家。

programme.title: 抢标房地产第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 凤凰城房地产拍卖市场又再拍卖，所有买家都争相竞标。本周，有人独具慧眼，看出房子致命的问题，可是有人看不出问题来，要倒赔一大笔。

programme.title: 行李战争第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 买家到洛杉矶一处警察拍卖会上竞标遭没收的物品与资产。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注急流篇第7季:第3集
programme.desc: 达斯汀的团队成功在金块溪采集到第一个块金，大大振奋了士气。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第13季:第3集
programme.desc: 德鲁与堤伊再度踏上寻找旧货之旅，这次他们横跨英国到许多偏远地区。一处是位于英格兰最东边的诺福克郡，一处是位于威尔斯西南、荒凉偏僻的彭布罗克郡，另外还造访了艾色克斯的罗治福区。这些地方开车都需要四、五个小时的车程，究竟这些千里迢迢才能抵达的地点，是否能让德鲁买到他理想中的旧货呢？让我们一起看下去。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 旧货商东尼基林受人之托，找到马汀帮忙修复一样家传之宝，这是一件第二次世界大战的飞行夹克，空战英雄留下的古董，在马汀的细心修补下，重新赋予这件夹克生命，让后代可以继续纪念祖先的历史。德鲁这次继续挑战铁匠内韦尔和灯具专家裘琳的功力，他们也不负所托，让惨不忍睹的壁炉椅，和支离破碎的洋葱吊灯死起回生，延续新的生命。

programme.title: 翻新中古车第18季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，麦克和艾维斯联手出击，挑战以低成本取得并翻新中古超跑，好让买家能以最划算的价格充分拥有超跑体验。处理麻烦的零件，进行机械维修等，达成目标的过程不易，却也处处是惊喜，一起来见识这项任务的趣味所在！

programme.title: 安特-天生技师第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 安特放手一搏，买下一辆第一代卡普里。女友芮妮齐薇格给了他一个很酷的惊喜。

programme.title: 人体不思议第6季:第13集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，患有牟比士症候群而半边脸麻痹的丹妮要动面部手术，让她能够第一次露出微笑；患有表皮松解症的狄恩力抗万难，一再颠覆医生们的预料生存下来，不让罕见的皮肤病击倒他；患有侏儒症的约翰曾经病态肥胖，但他克服了自身的缺陷，成为征服多场马拉松的精英运动员。

programme.title: 问题皮肤救星第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 四名受到皮肤问题困扰的患者登门寻求艾玛医师的协助。

programme.title: 最腻姊妹档第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 小薇跟艾许莉的母亲因为代孕一事起口角；兰笛终于要拆掉牙套；露西与安娜试图找工作；洁西卡与乔许跟克莉丝汀娜与约翰共进晚餐，。

programme.title: 风城改造专家第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 本集艾莉森和唐纳文将前往皮尔斯大道，改造一栋遭祝融肆虐的老式住宅，不仅翻修困难重重，他们更遇到前所未有的重大差错，究竟两人能否逆转失误、再现1880年代老屋的风华？

programme.title: 时人杂志犯罪调查第4季:第6集
programme.desc: 乐天开朗的雪萝寇克曾经是单亲妈妈，独自一人扶养女儿玛丽莎，后来她在通用汽车的生产线找到工作，同时经由工作认识了比尔，两人迅速坠入情网，虽然亲友都感到非常意外，因为比尔的个性与雪萝相差甚远，但比尔将玛丽莎视如己出，也非常照顾雪萝，亲友们因此也乐见其成。两人结婚后，比尔除了正式领养玛丽莎之外，两人也生了一个女儿米凯拉，但这段婚姻维系十多年后关系开始生变，雪萝发现比尔有外遇后大为崩溃，两人后来尝试维持开放式婚姻来延续这段感情，但比尔多次破坏规矩让雪萝再也无法忍受，就在雪萝把离婚协议书交给比尔的隔天，她竟然就此离奇失踪，嫌犯究竟是谁？

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第13集
programme.desc: 凯蒂伯顿前往枫糖浆厂去深入了解自然枫糖浆的制作过程。狄安娜尼尔森和保罗霍尔德曼两位厂主和其他枫糖浆制造商作法不同，以自然保留树木原始风味的方法来制作每批枫糖浆。在每道过程细心蒸发熬煮，产出的枫糖浆香气与风味也随之与众不同。

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，凯蒂今天要使用的食材是海带，海带对美国人来说是一种很少食用的食材；然而海带的美味以及带给环境的益处却超乎所想。凯蒂将用海带料理奶油培根义大利面，而海带料理专家伊尔玛也将带来海带吉拿棒料理。

programme.title: 好屋重生记第5季:第9集
programme.desc: 在本集节目中，因为弟弟泰德搬出了米娜的房子，所以她决定翻修这间和先生一起投资的第一间房产。除了一些小波折，翻修过程一切顺利。他们还邀请房仲来参观翻修后的房子，并听取他们的建议。最后他们会决定要立刻出售房产，还是再多等几年呢？锁定本节目观赏精彩内容。

programme.title: 到英国结婚去第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 露易丝与荷西举办宝宝性别揭晓派对，莫特拿到签证，却不告诉夏恩什么时候要去英国，蒂恩即将前往多明尼加共和国，和交往不久的男朋友大卫同居。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第16季:第13集
programme.desc: 新娘TK带著七人亲友团进来店里挑婚纱，因为七是她和丈夫的幸运数字。但蓝迪和顾问布兰蒂发现要找到让七人及新娘都很满意的那一件婚纱不简单。新娘莱丝莉带著妈妈和好闺密一起来找婚纱，妈妈一进店里就看中一件婚纱，但莱丝莉认为应该再多看几件才下决定。

programme.title: 牵手开餐厅第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 妮可与艾伦的房仲为他们介绍了一名潜在的投资人。珍妮特为了帮蓝迪开餐厅暂时放下自己的梦想。凯萨琳与奈特找到理想的餐厅地点。

programme.title: 离开美国结婚去第7季:第4集
programme.desc: 路克与麦德琳的婚礼岌岌可危。玛侬则在生活中苦苦挣扎。克萝伊的阿鲁巴之梦开局并不顺遂。

programme.desc: 洁西卡和准妹婿约翰决定碰面谈和；安娜与露西第一天在餐厅上班；小薇和艾希莉见生殖科医生；史坦顿岛三胞胎筹备大规模募款活动。

programme.desc: 本集艾莉森和唐纳文将前往皮尔斯大道，改造一栋遭祝融肆虐的老式住宅，不仅翻修困难重重，他们更遇到前所未有的重大差错，究竟两人能否逆转失误、再现1880年代老屋的风华？

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第9季:第10集
programme.desc: 教师夫妇麦可和萝伦热爱四处旅游及展开冒险的生活方式，现在因为新的工作机会，他们决定带著小儿子从卡达搬到马来西亚。

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第9季:第11集
programme.desc: 克里斯在华府担任律师，在事务所内一路往上爬，当他到了顶点，却觉得这不是他想要的生活，他休了长假去东南亚自助旅行，因此爱上了新加坡。

programme.title: 假体真做第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 杰先前罹患癌症后，最后不幸失去整个外鼻，艾莉森依照他过往的照片模拟原本的鼻形和肤色，为他制作一个新的义鼻。

programme.title: 免拆屋大改造第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，珍要帮三个小孩的单亲妈妈海莉改造居家环境，海莉家中充满50年代糖果色调，而且几乎没有收纳空间。而另一组客户的房子空间虽大，却没善加利用，屋内还有各种老旧设计。珍这次会用什么妙招，进行免拆屋大改造呢？

programme.title: 豪华原木屋第4季:第7集
programme.desc: 达斯汀与萝拉希望能远离城市生活，搬到加州猛玛湖区永久定居。

programme.title: 豪华原木屋第4季:第8集
programme.desc: 住在田纳西州郊区的麦特和安琪，为了让一家人有更多时间相处，打算在大烟山附近买下一间度假原木屋。

programme.title: 贝琳大声说第2季:第13集
programme.desc: 在伦敦与日益严重的抽动症状对抗后，贝琳终于有机会尝试一款可能帮助她减轻抽动、甚至彻底改变人生的装置。

programme.title: 风城改造专家第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 本集的风城改造专家来到一间历史房屋。由于历史房屋的整建需要遵循地标局的规范，因此他们买下房屋后又等了八个月才开始动工。为了弥补闲置工程所耗费的时间和开销，团队在一个月内飞快赶工，并保留下屋内大量古老精致的原始家具，搭配符合风格的仿饰配件，将这间房子的门面和内部装潢改造成具有现代和原始历史感的精致小屋，最后以130万高价卖出。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱-谭法兰斯第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 琪拉已经试穿过21件婚纱，却迟迟没找到梦幻婚纱。在谭法兰斯抽丝剥茧之下，他发现是因为琪拉最爱的祖母在三个月前突然离世令她大受打击，所以才难以下定决心。

programme.title: 修复英式庄园第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 跟随建筑师迪恩波顿Dean Poulton与设计师博贾马夸Borja de Maqua，看他们亲手修复一座曾属于亨利七世国王、历经三百年岁月洗礼的英式庄园。这座曾经宏伟却日渐破败的皇家遗迹，在两人的巧思与工艺下，从中世纪风格重生，蜕变成梦幻庄园。

programme.title: 巴比家吃遍加州海岸第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，巴比富雷将带著女儿在洛杉矶品尝美食，包含泰国料理、炸鸡和松饼、墨西哥料理，和中东风格冰淇淋店。最后巴比在农夫市集买了食材，要做出向这些美食致敬的创意料理。

programme.title: 问题皮肤救星第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 患者凯莉从十几岁起就受青春痘所苦；浩尔的头皮后方长了脂肪瘤；戴夫深受皮肤搔痒所苦；克莉丝汀的背上有一颗囊肿。

programme.title: 时人杂志犯罪调查第4季:第8集
programme.desc: 2005年2月28日在芝加哥一位联邦法官家中，早晨一如往常地慌乱，家中么女抓了一片吐司就赶紧出门，女主人琼安勒夫科法官则与丈夫麦克亲吻道别后就出门上班了，留下丈夫与母亲两人在家。勒夫科法官在上班闲暇时间打给丈夫问候，却打了好几通电话都无人接听，让她觉得很不寻常。她傍晚６点回到家后，却发现家中异常安静，因此她往先生位于地下室的书房走，却惊见丈夫和母亲双双陈尸在地下室，头部中弹。她报警后，警方立刻赶到现场拉起封锁线，司法警察也赶紧将勒夫科法官及其女儿带到安全的地方予以保护。这宗双尸案牵涉到一位联邦法官、一位知名律师和一名慈爱的母亲，凶手的目的究竟为何？

programme.desc: 洁西卡和准妹婿约翰决定碰面谈和；安娜与露西第一天在餐厅上班；小薇和艾希莉见生殖科医生；史坦顿岛三胞胎筹备大规模募款活动。

programme.desc: 本集的风城改造专家来到一间历史房屋。由于历史房屋的整建需要遵循地标局的规范，因此他们买下房屋后又等了八个月才开始动工。为了弥补闲置工程所耗费的时间和开销，团队在一个月内飞快赶工，并保留下屋内大量古老精致的原始家具，搭配符合风格的仿饰配件，将这间房子的门面和内部装潢改造成具有现代和原始历史感的精致小屋，最后以130万高价卖出。

programme.title: 恶女命案第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 真实生活中的谜团勾勒出女性关系与竞争背后的黑暗面。谁才是女王？谁是小跟班？谁又为了嫉妒与八卦而活？有时候，这些复杂的互动关系，引爆令人震惊的身心暴力行径。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱-谭法兰斯第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 琪拉已经试穿过21件婚纱，却迟迟没找到梦幻婚纱。在谭法兰斯抽丝剥茧之下，他发现是因为琪拉最爱的祖母在三个月前突然离世令她大受打击，所以才难以下定决心。

programme.title: 时人杂志犯罪调查第4季:第8集
programme.desc: 2005年2月28日在芝加哥一位联邦法官家中，早晨一如往常地慌乱，家中么女抓了一片吐司就赶紧出门，女主人琼安勒夫科法官则与丈夫麦克亲吻道别后就出门上班了，留下丈夫与母亲两人在家。勒夫科法官在上班闲暇时间打给丈夫问候，却打了好几通电话都无人接听，让她觉得很不寻常。她傍晚６点回到家后，却发现家中异常安静，因此她往先生位于地下室的书房走，却惊见丈夫和母亲双双陈尸在地下室，头部中弹。她报警后，警方立刻赶到现场拉起封锁线，司法警察也赶紧将勒夫科法官及其女儿带到安全的地方予以保护。这宗双尸案牵涉到一位联邦法官、一位知名律师和一名慈爱的母亲，凶手的目的究竟为何？

programme.title: 最腻姊妹档第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 洁西卡和准妹婿约翰决定碰面谈和；安娜与露西第一天在餐厅上班；小薇和艾希莉见生殖科医生；史坦顿岛三胞胎筹备大规模募款活动。

programme.title: 问题皮肤救星第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 患者凯莉从十几岁起就受青春痘所苦；浩尔的头皮后方长了脂肪瘤；戴夫深受皮肤搔痒所苦；克莉丝汀的背上有一颗囊肿。

programme.title: 六千金在我家第5季:第17集
programme.desc: 丹妮尔和亚当继续大聊每个女儿的个性和独特之处。芮莉从在妈妈肚子里就又踢又闹，长大后更是独树一格。奥莉薇亚从小就搞笑到不行，长大后更是五胞胎里的开心果。

programme.title: 跟著艾琳去流浪第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 艾琳弗兰奇和丈夫麦可来到德州，希望能大啖德州烤肉。

programme.title: 造美宅好扎根第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 本集中班和克莉丝蒂帮一个多元文化家庭设计厨房和露台，除了让整个空间更开放，他们也利用缤纷多彩的建材和多种元素，打造出多文化融合的家。

programme.title: 最腻姊妹档第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 露西与安娜终于要去拔牙；洁西卡与克莉丝汀娜准备了助孕大餐给乔许；小薇与艾许莉的代孕计划触礁；乔登想主导兰笛的婚礼。

programme.title: 修复英式庄园第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 跟随建筑师迪恩波顿Dean Poulton与设计师博贾马夸Borja de Maqua，看他们亲手修复一座曾属于亨利七世国王、历经三百年岁月洗礼的英式庄园。这座曾经宏伟却日渐破败的皇家遗迹，在两人的巧思与工艺下，从中世纪风格重生，蜕变成梦幻庄园。

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第9季:第10集
programme.desc: 教师夫妇麦可和萝伦热爱四处旅游及展开冒险的生活方式，现在因为新的工作机会，他们决定带著小儿子从卡达搬到马来西亚。

programme.title: 亚洲好住家第9季:第11集
programme.desc: 克里斯在华府担任律师，在事务所内一路往上爬，当他到了顶点，却觉得这不是他想要的生活，他休了长假去东南亚自助旅行，因此爱上了新加坡。

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 文斯和淑缇在新加坡东部租屋已经七年了，这对有一个两岁小孩的夫妇，已准备好购置新家迎接更多孩子出世。

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 夏鲁成年之后大部分都是租房子，但是好客的他准备好要买一间自己的房子，方便招待朋友。

programme.title: 跟著艾琳去流浪第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 艾琳弗兰奇和丈夫麦可来到德州，希望能大啖德州烤肉。

programme.title: 风城改造专家第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 艾莉森维多莉亚和唐纳文艾克哈德处理一间有可观获利潜力的顶楼公寓，但过程却麻烦不断，他们能否在时限内成功完成公寓翻修呢？

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第15集
programme.desc: 本集的主题是菇类。主持人凯蒂伯顿拜访新创公司蘑菇农场。凯蒂与蘑菇农场一同了解许多大众不会食用的菇类，例如猴头菇、蓝蚝菇和玉皇菇，并努力推广它们，让人们喜欢上这些菇类。

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 凯蒂伯顿为了进一步了解海鲜如何从水里捕捞上岸，亲自跟著渔船一起出海捕鱼，然后利用简单的调味和料理方式，烹调出食材的新鲜和美味。

programme.title: 免拆屋大改造第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 主持人珍最擅长不更动房屋结构，帮屋主设计出全新的风格，本集节目的两位屋主，各自有自己的难题，不过珍还是发挥她的设计天分，交出漂亮的成绩单。

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 马可斯和里昂兄弟档当了一辈子的室友，现在准备结合两人的资金，购买更大的家，让彼此能有各自的房间。两兄弟能找到理想的家，而且有足够空间让他们和母亲同住吗？

programme.title: 亚洲房屋猎人第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 哈皮斯、莎姿和他们的三个小孩住在两房公寓，显得拥挤不堪，提升居住品质的时候到了，但是这对年轻夫妇对于梦幻住家的样貌，有截然不同的想法。

programme.title: 为了妈妈去杀人第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 原本该是最纯粹的母子羁绊，却演变成阴谋操控与致命背叛。节目摊开令人毛骨悚然的真实案件，在贪婪与复仇的驱使下，亲情如何扭曲成为残酷的犯罪，在美国各地留下无法抹去的伤痕。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第5季:第6集
programme.desc: 杰夫医生有一位常客将六只小猫送给诊所，众员工每天轮流抽出时间和牠们互动，接著也进行绝育手术，以利后续进行开放领养的作业。母狗跳跳的后腿长了一个肿瘤，饲主很担心牠必须截肢，但杰夫医生将肿瘤切除干净，让跳跳可以继续陪伴饲主。母猫吉蒂不慎伤到膝盖，艾咪医生替牠进行稳固膝盖骨的手术，牠之后也顺利康复。杰夫医生和技师海克特到野生动物庇护所，替一只公虎进行结扎手术，手术没有杰夫想像中顺利，所幸还是圆满结束任务。

programme.title: 蛇的秘密世界第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 牠们是顶尖猎人、终极生存者，也是长久以来被误解的掠食者。跟著节目揭开蛇的秘密世界，踏上一段精彩旅程，探索蛇类多样的栖息地、非凡的适应能力，以及牠们与人类之间错综复杂的关系。迅速致命的伪装大师，蛇类是地表上最令人畏惧的生物之一，每年造成超过十万人死亡。然而，这些被贴标签成危害人命的掠食者，其实往往是人类侵占栖地的受害者，也因此才引发一连串危险而难解的冲突。《蛇的秘密世界》带领观众深入蛇类不为人知的一面，揭露牠们令人震撼的生存策略。

programme.title: 乔治亚水族馆第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 水族馆要将一个栖地翻修成河口沼泽并养满短吻鳄。专业团队要对鲸鲨进行减感训练，在进食时减速并让潜水员共游。兽医分别为绿蠵龟坦克和海獭吉普森进行体检。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 在非洲大陆，水扮演著重要角色，因为水的出现和消失造成的地貌改变，影响动物的生活。

programme.title: 珍奇大自然第1季:第12集
programme.desc: 塞伦盖提的河流是庞然大物的家，即将成为巨物的河马和鳄鱼都要尽早开始学习，如何在塞伦盖提的水世界奋战。

programme.title: 爱心动物农场第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 这集的爱心动物农场中，谷仓收容所要帮忙接手两只来自匈牙利的曼加利察猪，接手仔猪的同时，丹和克里斯见到猪的原饲主，听了一段感人的故事，可以预期的是，两只仔猪在谷仓收容所，一定会过得很开心；另外这集节目中，公鸡罗伊动手术切除骨增生，鸟禽手术风险很高，所幸手术一切顺利；还有山羊史提夫因会冲撞其他动物而在角上套上泡棉条。

programme.title: 动物牠最毒第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 世界上的有毒动物用毒物和毒液互相对抗了好几百万年，地球上每个角落都是战场，牠们躲在海床底下、埋伏在黑暗的缝隙里、穿梭在浓密的树丛中。精心淬炼出的致命混合物，一滴就能要命。且跟著节目的脚步，一睹从沙漠到海洋，各种知名有毒动物的独门绝技。

programme.title: 动物情深第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 洁萨金特是一位成功的练马师，专长是训练比竞技的马和骑士。她从小就不喜欢大海和海洋动物，但多年前她和先生去土克斯及开科斯群岛度假时，却和一只名叫乔乔的海豚成了好朋友。每当洁的船只靠近，乔乔就会游来邀请洁一起玩耍。乔乔甚至还带著洁认识牠的太太波和孩子。但洁后来得了癌症和肾衰竭，必须常去医院治疗。后来在医生的允许下，洁终于在多年后回到土克斯及开科斯群岛。她很担心乔乔已经忘了她了，但经过几天搜寻，她终于找到乔乔一家人了。

programme.title: 乔治亚水族馆第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 海豹塞比的前脚蹼似乎不太舒服，兽医决定让牠接受雷射疗法。水族馆准备迎接两只新来的海豚。团队远赴圣赫勒拿岛，研究鲸鲨的交配行为。

programme.title: 动物牠最毒第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 世界上的有毒动物用毒物和毒液互相对抗了好几百万年，地球上每个角落都是战场，牠们躲在海床底下、埋伏在黑暗的缝隙里、穿梭在浓密的树丛中。精心淬炼出的致命混合物，一滴就能要命。且跟著节目的脚步，一睹森林和草原里，各种知名有毒动物的独门绝技。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第5季:第7集
programme.desc: 美国繁殖场狗救援组织的泰瑞莎从幼犬繁殖场载回40只迷你澳洲牧羊犬，一向主张为饲养的动物做绝育处理的杰夫医生，义不容辞前去帮忙，并带回一只公狗安迪回诊所训练并安排送养。主人失手将六个月大的幼犬切奇从围篱顶摔落，造成后腿骨裂。有民众送来一只逗留在车子引擎盖上，推测只有4到6个星期大的幼猫，身上又脏又臭，一只眼睛还感染发炎。宠物计划员工的宠物来自家诊所看诊免费，今天克莉丝汀带著牠的吉娃娃马歇尔来治疗髌股脱位。收容农场动物的爱德华基金会是非营利组织，他们一个立志当兽医的六年级小志工莉亚，发现有只羊驼Q因为下颔骨感染而肿起，杰夫医生采用新的串珠型抗生素来治疗。

programme.title: 动物情深第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 洁萨金特是一位成功的练马师，专长是训练比竞技的马和骑士。她从小就不喜欢大海和海洋动物，但多年前她和先生去土克斯及开科斯群岛度假时，却和一只名叫乔乔的海豚成了好朋友。每当洁的船只靠近，乔乔就会游来邀请洁一起玩耍。乔乔甚至还带著洁认识牠的太太波和孩子。但洁后来得了癌症和肾衰竭，必须常去医院治疗。后来在医生的允许下，洁终于在多年后回到土克斯及开科斯群岛。她很担心乔乔已经忘了她了，但经过几天搜寻，她终于找到乔乔一家人了。

programme.title: 爱心动物农场第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 豪宅猪舍落成启用，猪只陆续搬进去，但一开始免不了要打经过打架决定各自在猪群中的位阶；体型最大、体重最重的贾斯伯成了首领。一直和牛群住在一起的小子也终于在工作人员的忐忑中住进新猪舍，和猪群一起生活。谷仓收容所全体员工邀请志工与赞助人一起参加落成启用剪彩典礼。第一只获救的小牛离世一周年，为了纪念牠，丹将牠的照片纹在手臂上，农场也特地种植一棵山茱萸和树立牌匾。纽约州的胡士托农场收容所要营救一批退休蛋鸡，谷仓收容所受邀救回十只母鸡和两只公鸡。同时也试著让斗鸡汉弥尔顿及史特劳斯认识母鸡，但史特劳斯依旧斗性未驯，吓走母鸡。谷仓收容所想借助丰富化与玩具增进火鸡的生活品质，大伙儿为火鸡演奏音乐，让火鸡玩乐器。

programme.title: 小动物狠角色第1季:第15集
programme.desc: 娇小的动物虽然不太起眼，但有些小动物却拥有令人大开眼界的超强能力。本集节目要介绍的是泰国竹林里的独角仙。以昆虫的标准来说，独角仙的体型已经非常可观，这种昆虫界的摔角选手拥有天生神力，不仅可以用两支大角夹住与之竞争的同类对手，甚至还能推动比自己体重还多五百倍的木材，大力士的称号非牠莫属。

programme.title: 野地大胆王第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 卡悠提前往澳洲，找寻独树一格的守宫。澳洲有超过六百种蜥蜴，其中将近三分之一是守宫。

programme.title: 蛇的秘密世界第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 牠们是顶尖猎人、终极生存者，也是长久以来被误解的掠食者。跟著节目揭开蛇的秘密世界，踏上一段精彩旅程，探索蛇类多样的栖息地、非凡的适应能力，以及牠们与人类之间错综复杂的关系。迅速致命的伪装大师，蛇类是地表上最令人畏惧的生物之一，每年造成超过十万人死亡。然而，这些被贴标签成危害人命的掠食者，其实往往是人类侵占栖地的受害者，也因此才引发一连串危险而难解的冲突。《蛇的秘密世界》带领观众深入蛇类不为人知的一面，揭露牠们令人震撼的生存策略。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第5季:第7集
programme.desc: 美国繁殖场狗救援组织的泰瑞莎从幼犬繁殖场载回40只迷你澳洲牧羊犬，一向主张为饲养的动物做绝育处理的杰夫医生，义不容辞前去帮忙，并带回一只公狗安迪回诊所训练并安排送养。主人失手将六个月大的幼犬切奇从围篱顶摔落，造成后腿骨裂。有民众送来一只逗留在车子引擎盖上，推测只有4到6个星期大的幼猫，身上又脏又臭，一只眼睛还感染发炎。宠物计划员工的宠物来自家诊所看诊免费，今天克莉丝汀带著牠的吉娃娃马歇尔来治疗髌股脱位。收容农场动物的爱德华基金会是非营利组织，他们一个立志当兽医的六年级小志工莉亚，发现有只羊驼Q因为下颔骨感染而肿起，杰夫医生采用新的串珠型抗生素来治疗。

programme.title: 动物牠最毒第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 世界上的有毒动物用毒物和毒液互相对抗了好几百万年，地球上每个角落都是战场，牠们躲在海床底下、埋伏在黑暗的缝隙里、穿梭在浓密的树丛中。精心淬炼出的致命混合物，一滴就能要命。且跟著节目的脚步，一睹森林和草原里，各种知名有毒动物的独门绝技。

programme.title: 野性尚比亚第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 住在非洲大草原的动物，每天都要为了求生奋战，猎人是专业杀手，猎物也是防御大师。在旱季的高峰期，卢安瓜河是唯一可靠的水源，动物都被吸引到这里，河湾处住著瓦氏赤羚，狒狒群还有珠鸡群，牠们组成联盟互相守望相助，逃离掠食者。到了晚上，瓦氏赤羚成群结队待在开阔的平原上，虽然夜视能力不强，但凭借嗅觉，及四脚弹跳的绝招，也能逃过掠食者的追捕，狒狒群跟珠鸡则是躲到高高的树上；当雨季来临时，赤羚群会离开河岸，移到新的牧草地，但珠鸡却无处可去，但河谷的邻居们也少不了胆大，吵闹，又擅长躲避麻烦的珠鸡。

programme.title: 与象同行第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 南非的波札那住著全世界数量最多的非洲象，牠们每年都会展开一场迁徙之旅，横跨波札那，前往奥卡凡哥三角洲。大象保育先锋列维森现在要展开一场前所未有的任务，那就是跟著象群的脚步，和牠们一起踏上这场浩大征途，他找来当地的布什曼人导游卡内作他的向导，两人要一路追踪象群的足迹，在这趟旅途当中，他也将见证象群面临的生存挑战，和当地居民之间与象群的冲突。

programme.title: 动物求生高手第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 揭晓自然界的伪装高手，从微型刺客到顶级掠食者，全都是奇特的生物，展现出不可思议的力量。

programme.title: 乔治亚水族馆第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 海豹塞比的前脚蹼似乎不太舒服，兽医决定让牠接受雷射疗法。水族馆准备迎接两只新来的海豚。团队远赴圣赫勒拿岛，研究鲸鲨的交配行为。

programme.title: 多多爱动物第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 美国退伍军人潘恩曾在阿富汗服役。在战乱中，当地的狗儿抚慰了他失去战友的心，返回美国时，却因无法带同甘共苦的狗儿回家而伤心不已。于是他再次回到阿富汗，成立了阿富汗唯一官方的动物收容所，帮助照顾美国士兵在阿富汗救回来的狗，并且送回美国与美国士兵团聚，抚慰他们的心灵。

programme.title: 野地赢家第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 大猫是迷人的动物，也是可怕的猎人。住在巴西湿地的美洲豹，是两栖世界的顶级掠食者，称霸湿地跟雨林；美洲狮统治著智利的高地，靠绝佳的夜视力捕捉高地上的原驼；在纳米比沙漠流浪的沙漠狮，不管是狩猎或是养育孩子，靠的都是团队合作；除了沙漠狮，狞猫也是沙漠猎人，牠灵敏的大耳朵，可以听到猎物最微弱的声音；在非洲大草原上还有跑得最快的猎豹；除了牠们，在中国的东北花豹、俄罗斯的西伯利亚虎、还有西班牙的伊比利大山猫都是濒危物种，只有靠保育计划，才能确保这些物种能继续存活下去。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第5季:第8集
programme.desc: 小猫饼干因为好奇，把家里香料柜的培根袋取出，吃掉袋子里的矽胶干燥剂。牠后来牠吐了三次，呕吐物是淡黄色的，眼睛和鼻子也有些分泌物。兽医在为饼干检查后，发现饼干是铁中毒，因为有些干燥剂中含有能吸附水分的铁。饼干在中毒后就不吃不喝，而且变得很嗜睡。铁不但会造成脱水，对肝和胃也会造成严重伤害。宠物通常会在误食六小时内吐血，在二十四小时内肝脏受损。为了让饼干体内的毒素能尽快排出，兽医为牠进行静脉注射。还好饼干的主人能及时带牠到医院，牠后来终于恢复了。

programme.title: 与象同行第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 南非的波札那住著全世界数量最多的非洲象，牠们每年都会展开一场迁徙之旅，横跨波札那，前往奥卡凡哥三角洲。大象保育先锋列维森现在要展开一场前所未有的任务，那就是跟著象群的脚步，和牠们一起踏上这场浩大征途，他找来当地的布什曼人导游卡内作他的向导，两人要一路追踪象群的足迹，在这趟旅途当中，他也将见证象群面临的生存挑战，和当地居民之间与象群的冲突。

programme.title: 爱心动物农场第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 美国人道协会找丹合作营救北卡州一个受虐案的猪只，丹救回两只母猪与两只仔猪，却没想到其中一只母猪已经怀孕，回到谷仓收容所后不久便产下13只仔猪，开张才一个星期的豪华猪舍马上就要住满了。小鸭丽兹和索尔经过每天的物理治疗，可惜丽兹仍然不太能使用其中一条腿，所幸兽医检查说内部骨头没有受伤，持续物理治疗会有帮助。果然，一段时间后，两只小鸭第一次到池塘游泳便很成功。克里斯经过一个暑假的练习，终于能够抱起公鸡罗伊，给牠拥抱治疗。大谷仓上原本挂著马克南不动产几个字，那是丹的祖父公司的广告，如今正式改挂上谷仓收容所几个大字，象征了转变与世代交替。

programme.title: 了不起的非洲动物第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 每年，数百万只动物迁徙穿越壮阔的非洲大草原：感受牛羚如雷奔腾的蹄声，聆听大象低沉的鸣叫，见识猎豹与花豹疾速出击的瞬间，再与鬣狗在荒野嚎叫，陪伴狮群一起漫步，跟随秃鹫乘著热气流翱翔。然而，在这片看似熟悉的野性世界背后，残酷的现实鲜少被看见：90%的猎豹幼崽无法存活到成年，某些秃鹫物种仅剩不到20对繁殖个体。节目深入揭示这些族群所面临的生存威胁，同时展现动物惊人的适应能力与动人故事，看牠们如何在严酷环境中进化、求生，甚至改变自己所栖息的周遭。

programme.title: 野性尚比亚第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 住在非洲大草原的动物，每天都要为了求生奋战，猎人是专业杀手，猎物也是防御大师。在旱季的高峰期，卢安瓜河是唯一可靠的水源，动物都被吸引到这里，河湾处住著瓦氏赤羚，狒狒群还有珠鸡群，牠们组成联盟互相守望相助，逃离掠食者。到了晚上，瓦氏赤羚成群结队待在开阔的平原上，虽然夜视能力不强，但凭借嗅觉，及四脚弹跳的绝招，也能逃过掠食者的追捕，狒狒群跟珠鸡则是躲到高高的树上；当雨季来临时，赤羚群会离开河岸，移到新的牧草地，但珠鸡却无处可去，但河谷的邻居们也少不了胆大，吵闹，又擅长躲避麻烦的珠鸡。

programme.desc: 从北方的冻原，热带的雨林，到干旱的沙漠，这些空中的野地刺客翱翔在世界各地。牠们都拥有强大的体力、速度和视力，配备了最要命的利爪和最锋利的尖嘴。

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第26集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片第1004集
programme.desc: 在艾克米建筑公司，兔巴哥跟萝拉兔带领一群建筑师，坦白说，他们都不应该靠近任何建筑工地，但是，他们像团队一样合作，太菲鸭、猪小弟、崔弟还有其他伙伴，用他们的工具跟工程车完成许多史上最疯狂的工程。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第69集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第62集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 少年悍将 Go第1142集
